issues: Residuals r = y - base_tr are in-sample (base_tr comes from a model fit on the same training points), so they are shrunk toward zero and carry little signal; out-of-fold residuals would be the sound version. Not a correctness bug.
The code assumes the first N_BITS columns of Xtr/Xte are the binary Morgan bits; not verifiable from the diff alone. If wrong the similarity is distorted, but no leakage occurs.
With scaffold-disjoint folds few test molecules have a training neighbour above the 0.5 similarity cut, so the correction is often zero.
No gaming of the measurement: only train_y and test-side features are used, no file/network access, no pasted answers.
No claims conflict with the reported numbers; candidate is marginally worse and the reject decision is consistent.
